statement: The function returns a result r and r = max({0} union {j - i + 1 | 0 <= i < j < len(nums) and nums[i] > nums[j]}). Equivalently: r = 0 if there are no indices i, j with 0 <= i < j < len(nums) and nums[i] > nums[j]; otherwise r is the largest integer L for which there exist i, j with 0 <= i < j < len(nums), nums[i] > nums[j], and j - i + 1 = L.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 100000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -1000000000 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: The function returns a result r for every nums satisfying the preconditions; it does not fail, panic, or overflow.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 100000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -1000000000 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, 0 <= r <= len(nums).
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 100000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -1000000000 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r != 1; that is, either r = 0 or 2 <= r <= len(nums).
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 100000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -1000000000 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = 0 if and only if there do not exist indices i, j with 0 <= i < j < len(nums) and nums[i] > nums[j].
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 100000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -1000000000 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with r > 0, there exist indices i, j such that 0 <= i < j < len(nums), nums[i] > nums[j], and j - i + 1 = r.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 100000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -1000000000 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every i, j with 0 <= i < j < len(nums) and nums[i] > nums[j], we have j - i + 1 <= r.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 100000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -1000000000 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = len(nums) if and only if nums[0] > nums[len(nums)-1].
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 100000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -1000000000 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: The function returns a result r and r = 0.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 100000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -1000000000 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000, and for every i with 0 <= i + 1 < len(nums), nums[i] <= nums[i+1].

statement: The function returns a result r and r = 2 if nums[0] > nums[1], and r = 0 otherwise.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 100000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -1000000000 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000, and len(nums) = 2.

statement: For every integer c, if b is a slice with len(b) = len(nums) and b[i] = nums[i] + c for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), and if -1000000000 <= b[i] <= 1000000000 for every i, then the function returns a result r on nums and a result r_b on b, and r = r_b.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 100000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -1000000000 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: For every l, m with 0 <= l <= m < len(nums), let b be the slice of length m - l + 1 defined by b[t] = nums[l + t] for every t with 0 <= t < m - l + 1. If r is the result on nums and r_b is the result on b, then r_b <= r.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 100000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -1000000000 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.
